SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.MONITORTMPLNAME, C.CONTAINERCATEGORYID CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, C.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, D.ISLOCKED FROM T_EMC_TEST_ORDER_CATEGORY A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON A.MONITORTMPLID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY C ON A.CONTAINERCATEGORYID = C.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST_METHOD D ON A.TESTMETHODID = D.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC

SELECT T.* FROM(SELECT DISTINCT MONITORTMPLID, O.ORGID, O.CONTAINERCATEGORYID, C.CONTAINERCATEGORYID CONTAINERCATEGORYCODE, CONTAINERGROUP, SAMPLEQTY, SAMPLEWEIGHT, FIXATIVE, COUNT( TESTMETHODID ) AS TESTMETHODQTY, B.MONITORTMPLNAME, C.CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME, LISTAGG(DISTINCT O.ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY O.ID) AS IDS, LISTAGG(DISTINCT O.TESTMETHODID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY O.TESTMETHODID) AS TMIDS, -- XMLAGG(XMLPARSE(CONTENT O.ID||',') ORDER BY O.ID).GETCLOBVAL() AS IDS, -- XMLAGG(XMLPARSE(CONTENT O.TESTMETHODID||',') ORDER BY O.TESTMETHODID).GETCLOBVAL() AS TMIDS, O.STORECONDITION FROM T_EMC_TEST_ORDER_CATEGORY O LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL B ON O.MONITORTMPLID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY C ON O.CONTAINERCATEGORYID = C.ID WHERE MONITORTMPLID IS NOT NULL AND O.CONTAINERCATEGORYID IS NOT NULL AND CONTAINERGROUP IS NOT NULL AND SAMPLEQTY IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MONITORTMPLID,MONITORTMPLNAME,O.ORGID,CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME,CONTAINERGROUP,SAMPLEQTY,SAMPLEWEIGHT,FIXATIVE,O.CONTAINERCATEGORYID,C.CONTAINERCATEGORYID,O.STORECONDITION )T
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_CORE_USER_PERMISSION UP WHERE UP.PERMISSIONTYPEID = 'T_CORE_ORG' AND UP.TARGETID = T.ORGID AND UP.USERID = #{loginUser.id})
ORDER BY
T.MONITORTMPLID, T.CONTAINERGROUP, T.CONTAINERCATEGORYID
